evidence: ref27/System/Applications/Utilities/System Information.app/Contents/Info.plist (document types txt, rtf, spreporter, spx; LSUIElement)

ref27/System/Applications/Utilities/System Information.app/Contents/Resources/Base.lproj/SPApp.nib (menus: Show System Report, Refresh Information, Show Less Information, Send to Apple, Speak Serial Number, Develop, Find)

ref27/System/Applications/Utilities/System Information.app/Contents/Resources/Base.lproj/SPWindow.nib (outline sidebar, item list, item detail, Preparing system profile sheet, Privacy Agreement panel)

features.apple: sidebar group of every hardware class (ATA, Audio, Bluetooth, Camera, Card Reader, Controller, Diagnostics, Disc Burning, Ethernet, Fibre Channel, Graphics/Displays, Memory, NVMe, PCI, Power, Printers, SAS, SATA, Storage, Thunderbolt, USB)
features.note: Nine hardware categories: Overview, Processor, Memory, Graphics, PCI, USB, Displays, Power, Storage.
features.wire: Add Audio, Bluetooth, Camera, Printers, Thunderbolt and NVMe/SATA categories to model::Category and ALL (model.rs:47), each filled from a new bifrost_core::sysinfo::Report list (sysfs: /sys/class/sound, /sys/class/bluetooth, /sys/class/video4linux, /sys/class/nvme, /sys/class/ata_port).

features.apple: Network group: Firewall, Locations, Volumes, WWAN, Wi-Fi
features.note: One Network category lists interfaces inside Hardware; there is no Network section.
features.wire: Add Section::Network to model.rs (Section enum, in_section) with Wi-Fi, Ethernet, Firewall, Volumes and WWAN categories; Firewall from the firewall service state, Volumes from mounts in Report.

features.apple: Software group: Accessibility, Applications, Developer, Extensions, Fonts, Frameworks, Installations, Language & Region, Logs, Preference Panes, Printer Software, Profiles, Startup Items, Sync Services
features.note: Only Operating System and Installed Apps.
features.wire: Add Fonts (Font Book catalogue), Extensions (kernel modules from /proc/modules), Startup Items (autostart and user units), Logs (journal summary), Language & Region and Preference Panes (settings pane list) categories to model.rs.

features.apple: SPOutlineView with disclosure triangles
features.note: Section headers and symbol rows via the shared source list; the headers cannot be collapsed.
features.wire: Make Hardware/Software headers collapsible in the SourceList (disclosure state kept in SysInfo) and persist it.

features.feature: Item list above an item detail pane
features.apple: split view: Contents list on top, details pane below
features.note: One key/value card per category; no selectable item list with a separate detail.
features.wire: In window.rs split the content into a list of items (one per device, disk, app) and a detail card for the selected item; model::rows returns Vec<Item> with a detail Vec<Row> each; keep the card for single-item categories.

features.apple: item detail rows
features.note: Key column and value column, scrolls with wheel, drag and arrow keys.

features.apple: first sidebar item Hardware Overview: model, chip, memory, serial, firmware, OS
features.note: Model, vendor, form factor, processor, memory, graphics, serial, operating system, kernel and firmware.

features.apple: Hardware > Processor / chip: cores, cache, speed
features.note: Name, vendor, logical processors, clock; no physical cores, cache sizes or per-core frequency.
features.wire: Extend bifrost_core::sysinfo cpu with physical cores, L1/L2/L3 sizes (lscpu fields from /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cache) and show them in the Processor rows.

features.apple: Hardware > Memory: type, speed, slots, manufacturer
features.note: Installed total only.
features.wire: Read DIMM type, speed and slots via the DMI memory device table in bifrost_core::sysinfo and list one row per slot.

features.apple: Graphics/Displays: chipset, VRAM, resolution
features.note: Graphics rows from PCI, displays with connector state and mode; no VRAM or per-display scale and refresh.
features.wire: Add VRAM (DRM sysfs mem_info_vram_total) and refresh rate/scale per display to Display in bifrost_core::sysinfo and display_row.

features.apple: Hardware > PCI
features.note: Address, vendor, class and driver per device.

features.apple: Hardware > USB: bus tree with speed, vendor, power
features.note: Flat list with manufacturer, speed and port; no hub/bus hierarchy or power draw.
features.wire: Group USB rows by bus and hub parent (sysfs devpath) with indentation and add bMaxPower to the row.

features.apple: Hardware > Power: battery cycle count, condition, charger
features.note: Source kind, capacity, status, health percentage and cycle count.

features.apple: Hardware > Storage / Volumes: capacity, free space, file system, SMART
features.note: Disk model, size, removable, SSD or HDD, partition count; no free space, file system or SMART status.
features.wire: Add per-partition file system, mount point, free space (statvfs) and SMART health (smartctl summary) to Disk in bifrost_core::sysinfo and expand disk_row into a row per volume.

features.apple: Network > Wi-Fi / Ethernet: addresses, MAC, state
features.note: Kind, state, MAC, default route, addresses; no DNS, gateway, speed or Wi-Fi signal and channel.
features.wire: Add gateway, DNS, link speed and Wi-Fi SSID/channel/signal (netd status) to NetInterface and net_row.

features.apple: Software > System / About: version, build, boot volume, uptime
features.note: Name, version, kernel; no build id, boot volume, host name, uptime or secure boot state.
features.wire: Add host name, uptime, boot volume and secure-boot state rows to Category::System.

features.apple: Software > Applications: name, version, source, 64-bit, last modified
features.note: Id and version only.
features.wire: Add display name, kind (system/store/user), install date and signature state columns to InstalledApp rows (app_row).

features.feature: Audio, Bluetooth, Camera, Printers, Thunderbolt hardware pages
features.apple: one page per hardware class
features.note: No such categories.
features.wire: Covered by the Hardware section row; add one Category variant per class with sysfs readers in bifrost_core::sysinfo.

features.apple: File/View > Refresh Information (cmd+R)
features.note: A toolbar Refresh button re-reads the report; no menu item or cmd+R.
features.wire: Declare a View menu (Refresh Information cmd+R) in main.rs via the app menu API used by activity-desktop (main.rs main_menu) and route cmd+R to SysInfo::reload (window.rs:74).

features.apple: progress sheet with Cancel while the profile loads
features.note: Report is read synchronously on launch; the window is blank until it finishes.
features.wire: Read the report on a worker thread, show a progress sheet with Cancel (SDK sheet kit) until it lands.

features.apple: View > Show Less Information (hides item detail or developer rows)
features.note: No concise/full toggle.
features.wire: Add a mini/full flag to SysInfo and a View menu toggle; the concise mode shows only the Overview rows.

features.feature: Save System Report as .spx / text / rich text
features.apple: File > Save; document types spx, txt, rtf
features.note: Nothing is exported.
features.wire: Add File > Save As… in main.rs that serializes every category's model::rows to a plain text and a JSON report file through the SDK save panel.

features.feature: Open a saved system report and Open Recent
features.apple: File > Open, Open Recent; spreporter and spx types
features.note: Cannot open a stored report.
features.wire: Register the report file type in manifest.toml, load a saved report into the model in place of the live one, and add Open Recent from the shell recent-items store.

features.apple: Edit > Find: Find Next/Previous, Use Selection for Find, Jump to Selection
features.note: No search over rows.
features.wire: Add a toolbar search field (kit search_field) to window.rs filtering rows across categories and Find Next/Previous menu items.

features.apple: Edit > Select All, Copy
features.note: Detail rows are not selectable or copyable.
features.wire: Add row selection to the detail card and cmd+C to place key: value lines on the shell clipboard.

features.apple: File > Send to Apple with privacy agreement panel
features.note: Uploads a profile to the vendor; BifrOSt has no such service.

features.apple: Window/Hardware > Speak Serial Number
features.note: No speech of the serial number.
features.wire: Add a menu item that sends the serial to the speech service (assistant-desktop tts path) and speaks it digit by digit.

features.feature: Develop menu: fill startup disk and memory thresholds
features.apple: Develop > Fill Startup Disk, 100 MB below/above warning and danger thresholds
features.note: Developer test tooling for low-disk handling, hidden behind a toggle.

features.apple: arrow keys move the sidebar selection
features.note: Up and down scroll the detail card; they do not move the sidebar selection.
features.wire: In main.rs route Up/Down to SysInfo::select with the previous/next Category when the sidebar has focus (window.rs:91) and add Tab to move focus between sidebar and card.

features.apple: item list and item detail with AXHelp text
features.note: Toolbar, sidebar rows and detail card are published controls and tappable through Activate.

features.apple: About, Hide, Hide Others, Show All, Services, Quit, Minimize, Bring All to Front
features.note: The shell frames the window and quits it; the app publishes no menu of its own.
features.wire: Publish an app menu (About System Information, Quit) and a Window menu from main.rs with the SDK menu API.

features.apple: System Information Help
features.note: No help.
features.wire: Add a Help menu entry that opens a short Help page in the shell help viewer.
